title.narrative: The young peoples’ battle - The mental health crisis in the urban slum areas of Zimbabwe

description.narrative: The young people of Zimbabwe are subjected to a serious mental health crisis. But they are not only victims. They are also the heroes, leading the fight for change.We at Operation Dagsværk (OD) want to conduct a preparatory study for our work with the project in Zimbabwe. The preparatory study will be carried out in cooperation with House of Arts Association (HAA) and their young volunteers in 12 slum areas across the cities of Harare and Bulawayo, facilitated by Dreamtown.In this pilot study young Danish volunteers will visit HAA and the young Zimbabwean volunteers, who are working to combat the mental health crisis affecting their generation. The purpose of the study is to investigate the challenges that the young Zimbabweans in strained communities experience and how the young volunteers are fighting for change, and then bring these stories back to Denmark. Through workshops and meetings with the volunteer communities, the Danish and Zimbabwean volunteers will decide which stories to tell the 60 000 students in Denmark, who will learn about the project.
